data.title: Career fair — booth 12
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Hi, I'm Rafael Okonjo, I recruit for mission operations at Kestrel Launch Systems. Speaker 2: Hi Rafael, I'm Dan. I've been looking at your flight controller trainee opening. Speaker 1: Great fit, from what you're describing. Send me your résumé and I'll pass it to the hiring manager. Speaker 2: I'll send it tonight. Speaker 1: And let's set up a screening call, maybe Thursday afternoon? Speaker 2: Thursday works. I'll reply to your scheduling email. Speaker 1: Also look at our engineering blog; the team posts about their console setup.
